papers.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of Fermi Gamma-Ray Burst Data. IV. Spectral Lag and its Relation to Ep Evolution
papers.classification: DEDICATED time-resolved analysis (sample of 92 pulses from 84 GRBs; ours gets its own 9-bin spectral sequence, a pulse fit, a lag table and an evolution class)
papers.weighting: Phase 3b PRIMARY comparison frame - newest dedicated analysis of this burst
papers.frame: RMFIT v4.3.2, Band function, joint fit, time bins built to SNR>40; TTE from the brightest detector(s); gtBurst + HEASOFT 6.20 + Fermi ST v10r0p5; Ep = nuFnu peak; Band-1993 index signs; times rel. GBM trigger. Lag tau-hat measured by CCF (10^3 Monte-Carlo light curves) against the 8-25 keV reference band; energy bands (1)25-50 (2)50-100 (3)100-300 (4)300-1000 keV NaI, (5)300-1000 (6)1000-5000 keV BGO. tau-hat_31 = lag(100-300 vs 25-50 keV). k_E = slope of log Ep vs log(t+t0); k_tau-hat = slope of tau-hat vs log E. Evolution class 'H' = hard-to-soft, assigned by eye (their Sect. 3.1).
papers.component_coverage: the single main pulse throughout: the 9 spectral bins span T0-0.64 -> T0+20.16 s, essentially our stamped window; the CCF interval is (0.0,20.0) s; the pulse fit is over the full NaI band.
papers.internal_consistency_check_run: tau-hat_31 recomputed from Table 3: 1.33 - 0.37 = 0.96, vs Table 4's 0.95 +/- 0.14. PASSES.

traps.T3: W is defined TWICE and both point at the same Table 4 column: Sect.3.1 'the pulse width W = T_d + T_r' (T_d,T_r measured between I_m and 0.1 I_m) vs Sect.3.2 'W is the full width at half maximum of the pulse observed at 8keV-1MeV'. The number W = 6.97 s must always be carried with this ambiguity note.
traps.T4: Table 3 is two-column; naive PyMuPDF reading order interleaves bn110920546 with our rows. Values were re-extracted with word coordinates (x within +/-260 pt of the row anchor). Band index (4) is NOT printed for this burst - the printed set is (1)(2)(3)(5), i.e. the BGO 300-1000 keV cross-check replaces the NaI 300-1000 keV band. Recorded as printed.

papers.title: A New Measurement of the Spectral Lag of Gamma-Ray Bursts and its Implications for Spectral Evolution Behaviors
papers.classification: DEDICATED sample analysis - 50 SINGLE-PULSED bright GBM GRBs (fluence > 5e-6 erg/cm2, 10-1000 keV), our burst is a full table row with its own figure-set panel
papers.frame: TTE of the BRIGHTEST NaI only (n1 for this burst); light curve split into nine consecutive energy channels chosen manually for S/N>5 per channel; Gaussian profile per channel (IDL GAUSSFIT); t_peak(E) = t0 + tau (E/1keV)^-beta [their Eq.2] and delta(E) = omega (E/1keV)^-gamma [Eq.5], fitted with PyMultiNest; T90 quoted FROM the GBM catalog (50-300 keV), not re-measured. dt_HR = CCF delay between the hardness-ratio evolution curve and the total light curve (their Sect. 4).
papers.component_coverage: the single pulse (that is the sample definition); T90 = 20.74 s is the catalog total.
papers.science_note: dt_HR = 3.317 +/- 0.207 s is among the LARGEST in their 50-burst sample (only 130704560's 5.19 +/- 4.42 s exceeds it, at 85% error), and tau = 27.8 s is a 1-keV extrapolation, not a measured band-to-band lag. Together with Lu+2018's 'H' class this makes GRB 111009A a long-lag / wide-pulse / hard-to-soft exemplar - a strong PRIOR that must be kept out of a blind fit (blind-first).
papers.frame_clash_recorded: Shao's tau (27.8 s, extrapolated to 1 keV) and Lu's tau-hat_31 (0.95 s, measured 100-300 vs 25-50 keV) are DIFFERENT quantities. They must never be averaged or diffed against each other; a Step-7 lag comparison must pick one definition and state it.
papers.pdf: Skills_training/Shao_2017_2017ApJ844126S.pdf (ALREADY IN CORPUS, row 30, read=N - G2 dedup, not re-fetched)
papers.prompt_sections: READ: Sect.2 (sample selection + the nine-channel construction) and Sect.3 up to Eq.5 (the t0/tau/beta/omega/gamma definitions), plus the Table 1 row; Sect.4 for the dt_HR definition and the HTS-vs-HIT argument. All prompt. Sect.5 discussion is short - optional.
papers.feeds_our_steps: Step 7 temporal (lag with an explicit sign/definition convention, pulse-width energy dependence gamma, hardness-intensity delay), Step 9 QC (their single-NaI choice vs our n0+n1+b0)
